mapper.insert: insert into tutor( tutor_no, employee_no, tutor_tagline, tutor_intro, tutor_wtime ) values( #{tutorNo}, #{employeeNo}, #{tutorTagline}, #{tutorIntro}, systimestamp )
mapper.update: update tutor set tutor_tagline = #{tutorTagline}, tutor_intro = #{tutorIntro}, tutor_etime = systimestamp where tutor_no = #{tutorNo}
mapper.select: select t.tutor_no, t.employee_no, a.account_name, a.account_phone, t.tutor_tagline from tutor t join employee e on t.employee_no = e.employee_no join account a on e.account_no = a.account_no order by t.tutor_no asc

select t.tutor_no, t.employee_no, a.account_name, a.account_phone, t.tutor_tagline from tutor t join employee e on t.employee_no = e.employee_no join account a on e.account_no = a.account_no where exists ( select 1 from tutor_subject ts where ts.tutor_no = t.tutor_no and ts.academy_subject_no = #{academySubjectNo} ) order by t.tutor_no asc

select t.tutor_no, t.employee_no, t.tutor_tagline, t.tutor_intro, t.tutor_wtime, t.tutor_etime, a.account_name, a.account_phone from tutor t join employee e on t.employee_no = e.employee_no join account a on e.account_no = a.account_no where t.tutor_no = #{tutorNo}

select e.employee_no, a.account_name from employee e join account a on e.account_no = a.account_no where e.employee_type = '강사' and e.employee_status = '재직' and not exists ( select 1 from tutor t where t.employee_no = e.employee_no ) order by a.account_name asc
